resources.string: Live coverage on Sun* Family Facebook Group

More than just a name, \"Root Further\" embodies the spirit every Sunner strives toward: always looking deeper in every context and continuously creating, expanding oneself to transcend the limits once set by oneself. Borrowing the metaphor of color theory — from just three primary colors: red, yellow, and blue — the boundless creativity of each individual can produce a near-infinite palette, with every hue representing unbounded breakthrough and innovation.

A colleague recognition and appreciation activity — happening for the first time for all Sunners. The activity will launch in November 2025, encouraging Sun* members to share recognitions and thank-yous to colleagues on the system announced by the organizing committee. This will serve as material for the Heads Council to reference when selecting award recipients.
